title: Viral RNA Isolation Using Promega Maxwell® HT Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Promega Maxwell® HT Viral TNA Kit
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Add binding beads to lysed samples
steps.instruction: Load lysed samples into a NEST 96‑deepwell plate placed on the magnetic module (slot 6) and add the binding beads to each well; this protocol handles up to 96 samples.

steps.title: Arrange reagents in reservoirs
steps.instruction: Place reagents in the two 12‑channel reservoirs according to the setup diagram provided for this protocol.

steps.title: Map samples to elution plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the contents of the magnetic extraction plate (magnetic module, slot 6) directly to the elution PCR plate (temperature module, slot 1) preserving well positions (e.g., A1 → A1, B1 → B1, … D2 → D2).

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters in the software interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if needed before proceeding.

steps.title: Upload custom labware JSON files
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and upload any custom labware files (.json extensions) required for the run.

steps.title: Upload protocol Python file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol script (.py extension) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware (plates, reservoirs, tip racks, modules) exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip rack, and the pipette using the OT App; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the viral RNA isolation protocol.
